title: The Effect of Exercise on Blood Glucose Levels in Patients With Type 1 Diabetes: A Comparison of 3 Long-acting Insulins
brief_summary: This trial is conducted in Europe. The aim of this research is to assess the impact of three basal (long-acting) insulin treatments on blood glucose levels in people with type 1 diabetes when performing physical exercise.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Type 1 Diabetes
* Current basal-bolus insulin therapy
* HbA1c \< 10%
* BMI \< 32 kg/m2

Exclusion Criteria:

* Proliferative Retinopathy / Maculopathy
* Recurrent major hypoglycaemias
* Impaired hepatic or renal function
* Cardiac Problems
* Uncontrolled hypertension
